lanes.name: o-json-jobs-data
lanes.done_when: the generator is deterministic (same bytes on every run); `o-json structure` reads the first file and fails on the second with its line and column
lanes.tests: a test that the generated file matches the checked-in one; story `doc/open-broken-shows-position.json` (`skip: gap` if red)

lanes.name: o-json-tutorial-blockers
lanes.scope: The TODO.md items named in the T1–T8 rows: `o-json -`, `enter` on an object cell, `w` onto an existing file, path chooser ranking, `n`/`N` with the query line on, the breadcrumb's name vs path, the export message, the >200-key error, the query-mode `{`/`u`/`[` bugs
lanes.done_when: each item has a story that was red and is green
lanes.tests: one story per item (stories before fixes)
depends: none (may run beside the data-follow lane; rebase after it)

lanes.name: o-json-guide-jobs
lanes.scope: Rewrite GUIDE as T1–T8 and A1–A5, in [o-json-terms](o-json-terms.md) terms; per-chapter generated **Keys** blocks; "Not yet" lines; README links
lanes.done_when: `TestCheatSheet` covers every chapter block; every README link to the guide resolves
lanes.tests: `TestCheatSheet`; a link check over GUIDE and README anchors

lanes.name: o-json-tapes-jobs
lanes.scope: 13 tapes by slug; gifs in `docs/img`; vhs-tutorial pages and a gallery under `workspace/test-archive/<date>/vhs/o-json-jobs/`
lanes.done_when: every tape records with no error frames; the gallery opens in the browser page (not `open file.gif`)
lanes.tests: the tapes' dry runs; frames checked for `Error:`

lanes.name: o-json-key-order
lanes.done_when: output equals input for an unedited document; A1 becomes "Edit a config file without wrecking it"

lanes.name: o-json-yank-path
lanes.done_when: each noun with a path has `yank-path`; one handler

lanes.name: o-json-broken-excerpt
lanes.done_when: the excerpt shows in the CLI and the viewer; the setting turns it off

lanes.name: o-json-value-search
lanes.done_when: values match; `n`/`N` work with the query line on

lanes.name: o-json-table-sort
lanes.done_when: sort by column both ways; export writes the sorted order

lanes.name: o-json-jsonl
lanes.done_when: `.jsonl` opens as an array; the shape over records; a jsonl write round-trips

lanes.name: o-json-big-files
lanes.done_when: a report with open time and RSS at three sizes, filed in o-plans

lanes.name: o-json-diff
lanes.done_when: `o-json diff` agrees with a jq-based check on test pairs

lanes.name: o-json-yaml
lanes.done_when: read and export round-trip on samples
